# Cookie Factory CLA Privacy Policy

This policy applies to the electronic Contributor License Agreement (CLA)
process for Cookie Factory.

## Information collected

When You accept the CLA through a pull-request comment, the CLA workflow records
GitHub account and contribution metadata, including:

- GitHub login and numeric account identifier
- Signing-comment identifier and timestamp
- Repository identifier and pull-request number

The workflow does not request Your legal name, postal address, telephone
number, or email address. Do not include additional personal information in the
signing comment.

## Purpose and legal record

This information documents which authenticated GitHub account accepted the CLA
and verifies CLA coverage for contributions. A GitHub account signature is
evidence of acceptance by that account; it is not independent proof of the
legal identity behind the account.

## Public storage and sharing

The signature record is stored in `cla/v1/signatures.json` on the public
`cla-signatures` branch of the Cookie Factory repository. The signing comment,
pull request, and related workflow logs are also processed and hosted by
GitHub. These records may be publicly accessible, copied, indexed, and archived
by GitHub and other parties.

GitHub processes this information under the
[GitHub Privacy Statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement).
No signature database is operated outside GitHub for this workflow.

## Retention and requests

Signature records are retained as part of the project's contribution and
licensing history. Send correction requests and privacy questions to
[Cook's Code, Inc.](mailto:cookscodeinc+github@gmail.com). Removing or
correcting a public record does not by itself revoke licenses granted for
Contributions already submitted under the CLA.
